meta.title: Career — Johan Nilsson
meta.description: Twenty-five years: EY and Cordial, strategy for SATS and Health & Fitness Nordic, ten years building Barry’s in the Nordics, Iberia, Switzerland and Finland.

sections.label: Career
sections.quote: From the strategy desk <t>to the studio floor.</t>
sections.sub: Consulting, then strategy for the Nordic market leader, then ten years building Barry’s across the Nordics and beyond.

sections.label: Barry’s
sections.title: Ten years, <t>three regions.</t>
sections.lede: Dates from public profiles; figures as reported in the trade press.

groups.label: Milestones
names: 2016 — Chief Executive Officer, Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic AB, Stockholm
2022 — Merger with BB Norway AS: eight studios in six Nordic cities, around 250 people
2022 — Barry’s Iberia: licence for Spain, with José Daniel García and Kevin Triguero
2024 — CEO & Partner, Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic AB
2025 — Partner, Barry’s Switzerland: the first studio in Zürich opens in November
2026 — Barry’s Helsinki opens

groups.label: On the record
names: “We share that vision for Barry’s future, and our role is more important than ever.” At the Nordic merger, 2022.
“Huge thanks to everyone who made this happen — it’s been an incredible team effort.” On Barry’s Helsinki, 2026.

sections.label: SATS · Health & Fitness Nordic
sections.title: Strategy for <t>150 clubs.</t>
sections.lede: Five years with the Nordic market leader in fitness, before the move to operating and investing.

groups.label: Roles
names: Director, Strategy & Business Development, Health & Fitness Nordic — 2009–2014. A group with SEK 1.7 billion in revenue: SATS (Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland), Fresh Fitness (Norway, Denmark), Metropolis (Sweden) and SAFE (Sweden, Finland)
Strategy & Concept Director, SATS — 2014

sections.label: Timeline
sections.title: From EY, 1999, <t>to two boards in sport.</t>

groups.label: Consulting
names: Senior Consultant, Ernst & Young Management Consulting — 1999–2001
Strategy Manager, Telia Sverige — 2001–2002
Partner, Cordial Business Advisers — 2001–2009
Strategy Department AB — management consulting, business development and interim management, since 2010

groups.label: Investing
names: Founding Partner, Stockholm Leisure Partners — since 2015. An investor focused on the health and fitness industry; investments have included Playbook App, ClassPass Nordics, REPEAT Fitness and Challengize

groups.label: Operating & investing
names: Partner, Barry’s Switzerland — Zürich, since May 2025
CEO & Partner, Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic AB — Stockholm, since January 2024
Partner & Active Board Member, Barry’s Iberia — since January 2023
Founding Partner, Stockholm Leisure Partners — since May 2015

groups.label: Boards in sport
names: Member of the Board (Ledamot, Förbundsstyrelsen), Svenska Innebandyförbundet — elected June 2026
Board Member, AIK — since March 2026

groups.label: Degree
names: Stockholm University — degree and years to be confirmed
